podcast.body: This album was released in 1994 and featured "Grace, Too" as its first track, which was performed on Saturday Night Live. It was one of six singles spun off from the record. "first track from their 1994 album Day for Nights and one of six singles from that record."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album, released in 1994, featured the song "Nautical Disaster," which grew from improvisations during live performances. "It tragically hit for 1994 and the day for night album with nautical disaster."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: While on his honeymoon, Rob Baker was preoccupied with ideas for album covers and promotional photos, making sketches and developing concepts. These initial ideas, though conceived around the time of *Fully Completely*'s creation, ultimately "turned into Day for Night," suggesting a later application of these creative concepts for a subsequent album. "But it ended up that all that stuff turned into day for night."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Tragically Hip's Fully Completely Reissue With Rob Baker
